comment:
* Main runtime interface for protobuf. Applications should interact with this interface (rather
 * than directly accessing internal APIs) in order to perform operations on protobuf messages.

methods.name: public static Protobuf getInstance()
methods.comment: Gets the singleton instance of the Protobuf runtime.

methods.name: public void writeTo(T message, Writer writer) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes the given message to the target {@link Writer}.

methods.name: public void mergeFrom(T message, Reader reader) throws IOException
methods.comment: Reads fields from the given {@link Reader} and merges them into the message.

methods.name: public void mergeFrom(T message, Reader reader, ExtensionRegistryLite extensionRegistry) throws IOException
methods.comment: Reads fields from the given {@link Reader} and merges them into the message.

methods.name: boolean isInitialized(T message)
methods.comment: Checks if all required fields are set.

methods.name: public Schema<T> schemaFor(Class<T> messageType)
methods.comment: Gets the schema for the given message type.

methods.name: public Schema<T> schemaFor(T message)
methods.comment: Gets the schema for the given message.

methods.name: public Schema<?> registerSchema(Class<?> messageType, Schema<?> schema)
methods.comment:
* Registers the given schema for the message type only if a schema was not already registered.
   *
   * @param messageType the type of message on which the schema operates.
   * @param schema the schema for the message type.
   * @return the previously registered schema, or {@code null} if the given schema was successfully
   *     registered.

methods.name: public Schema<?> registerSchemaOverride(Class<?> messageType, Schema<?> schema)
methods.comment:
* Visible for testing only. Registers the given schema for the message type. If a schema was
   * previously registered, it will be replaced by the provided schema.
   *
   * @param messageType the type of message on which the schema operates.
   * @param schema the schema for the message type.
   * @return the previously registered schema, or {@code null} if no schema was registered
   *     previously.
